outcome_detail: $200,000 settlement paid to the plaintiff, reported/confirmed December 2025 (WDRB, Dec. 17, 2025). Settlement allowed the plaintiff to avoid protracted litigation.
criminal_detail: No criminal charges reported against either accused officer. Justin LeMon was terminated by LMPD in April 2024 for 'conduct unbecoming' violations; the internal investigation did not sustain the sexual harassment/abuse allegations against him. Dale Cottongim received a reprimand and transfer and was exonerated on the sexual harassment allegation.
description: A female Louisville Metro Police Department officer, Christine Silk, sued Louisville Metro Government in June 2024 (Jefferson Circuit Court, No. 24-CI-004228) over sexual harassment she said she experienced as a recruit and trainee. The suit alleged that her field training officer, Justin LeMon, subjected her to unwanted physical contact, exposed himself, sent sexually charged text messages including a nude photo, requested nude pictures, and made demeaning comments; a second training-unit officer, Dale Cottongim, was also named. According to reporting, LeMon was terminated in April 2024 for conduct unbecoming violations, though the harassment allegations were not sustained internally, and Cottongim was reprimanded and transferred. The city settled the suit for $200,000, as reported in December 2025. No criminal charges were filed against either officer.
